steps.text: Oven to 220°C fan. Tray lined with baking paper.

Base: chicken mince (65/75 g), parmesan (12/15 g), oregano (1 g), half a beaten egg (25 g), salt, garlic powder. Mix hard with your hands for a full minute — it should turn tacky and hold together in one mass.
Press onto the paper into a 20 cm round, 5–6 mm thick and even. Wet fingers stop it sticking. Bake 15 minutes.

Meanwhile: pepper (90/110 g), mushrooms (90/110 g) and onion (30/40 g) sliced. Pan, rapeseed oil (her 5 g / him 6 g), high heat, 5 minutes — until the mushrooms have given up their water and taken colour. Spinach (60/80 g) in at the end to wilt. Season.
Base out. It should be firm, browned at the rim and lift cleanly off the paper. Blot the surface with kitchen paper.
Passata (100/120 g) spread thin, mozzarella (30/40 g) torn over, vegetables on. Back in for 8 minutes.
Salad alongside: lettuce (40/50 g), dressed with the olive oil (her 9 g / him 11 g — the finishing portion, per the D0-003 pan/finish oil split), lemon, salt and plenty of black pepper.

why: Blot the base. Chicken mince releases water as it bakes, and a wet base steams instead of crisping. Press it thin and even too — a thick middle stays raw while the rim burns.
notes: L2 coverage: every oven step (n1,3,5,6) carries tempC 220.

L4/L7 D0-003 split: table total oil was 14/17 g olive_oil in Phase 0. Split into rapeseed_oil (pan-heat portion, 5/6 g, matching the original step 4's own '5 g of the oil' pan figure) + olive_oil (finishing/dressing portion, 9/11 g) — 5+9=14, 6+11=17, sums exactly to the Phase 0 table total, no new grams introduced (rule 9).
Lettuce is NOT swapped to sweetheart_cabbage — this card's lettuce is used as whole salad leaves, not shredded, so the D0-003 condition does not hold here (rule 8's explicit carve-out).

L7 addedInContentPass case: oregano_dried (1/1 g) is a genuinely new covers entry not present in Phase 0 at all — allowed because it is flagged addedInContentPass in _ingredients.A.json (a weighed seasoning addition, rule 5), not a guessed re-plan.
L8: three tracks (oven, pan, prep) with clockStart coverage throughout — a genuine multi-component dinner.
